# Paquet autonome « align-native » : bibliothèque statique + programme de démonstration en C (test de bout en bout sur les fichiers de ref/).
# DAW n'a pas besoin de ce fichier (son build.rs compile les sources listées dans sources.txt) ; il sert à vérifier le paquet seul.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(FlibusteAlignNative LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  add_compile_definitions(NOMINMAX _USE_MATH_DEFINES)
endif()
file(STRINGS sources.txt ALIGN_SOURCES)
add_library(flibuste_align STATIC ${ALIGN_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(flibuste_align PUBLIC include PRIVATE third_party third_party/rubberband)
set_target_properties(flibuste_align PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Threads)
add_executable(align_demo demo/align_demo.c)
target_include_directories(align_demo PRIVATE third_party)
target_link_libraries(align_demo PRIVATE flibuste_align)
if(Threads_FOUND)
  target_link_libraries(align_demo PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
endif()
if(NOT MSVC)
  target_link_libraries(align_demo PRIVATE m stdc++)
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME align_demo COMMAND align_demo ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/ref/guide.wav ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/ref/double.wav ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/ref/onsets.txt)
